name: Love stuck
source:
Loren is very seriously ill, she is categorically not allowed to go out in the sunny time of the day. And Mateo is an artist working to improve the health of his girlfriend. Will he be able to achieve his goal? Or does Loren have her own plans for this? You will have to find it out!

[from [url=https://simemeow.itch.io/love-stuck]itch.io[/url]]
